annotationRationale: The sphere section is the incircle. The area-inradius relation finds its radius, and the Pythagorean theorem then finds the center-to-plane distance. Isosceles-triangle properties and the base-height area formula supply the triangle's area.
sourceMethod: Follows the official altitude, area, incircle-radius, and right-triangle method. Introduces a separate tangency point T and describes all auxiliary points without relying on the official diagram.

review.mathCheck: The altitude is √(225−144)=9, giving area 108 and inradius 108/27=4. The perpendicular center-to-plane distance is √(36−16)=2√5, choice D. Tangency to the three side segments identifies the section as the incircle.
review.sourceMethodCheck: Originally worded, faithful expansion of official 2019 AMC 10A solution 21, page 12: altitude, area, inradius, then spatial Pythagoras. Using tangency point T instead of D is consistent with the official figure.
review.annotationCheck: The explanation reconstructs both the area-inradius relation and the spatial right triangle. No material gap or incorrect direct concept.
